prompt.project_info: Create a realistic lazy-morning floor mirror selfie of an approved adult woman.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with messy low ponytail or loose bun, face-framing bedhead strands, soft serene gaze, slim athletic build, wearing an opaque white ribbed regular-length top and relaxed light lounge trousers or knee-length shorts.
prompt.composition_elements: Seated on wooden floor before a full-length mirror, leaning back comfortably on one arm, one knee raised and one leg tucked, phone at face level, natural daylight, bedroom context.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft morning daylight, gentle shadows, casual peaceful home atmosphere, authentic smartphone realism.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic mirror selfie, smartphone wide-angle look, seated full-body framing, natural proportions, realistic hair, fabric and floor detail.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A realistic lazy-Sunday morning floor mirror selfie of an approved adult woman with a messy low ponytail or loose bun, many face-framing bedhead strands, a soft serene gaze toward her phone, and a relaxed natural expression. She wears an opaque white ribbed regular-length top and relaxed light lounge trousers or knee-length shorts. She sits on a wooden floor before a full-length mirror, leaning back comfortably on one arm with one knee raised and the other leg tucked, holding the phone at face level. Use natural daylight, a calm bedroom, gentle shadows, authentic smartphone texture, realistic proportions, and detailed hair, fabric, floor and mirror reflection.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, underage, childlike, cropped top, exposed midriff, cleavage, thin tank, body-part emphasis, sexualized pose, nudity, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, public figure likeness.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required environment reference. Preserve approved-adult identity, hair, bedroom, mirror, white palette, phone and morning light; use equally opaque clothing and a comfortable seated pose. Keep typography absent.
